## GLM 5.2 E2EE API

GLM 5.2 E2EE is a large language model by Z.ai, available on the Venice API as `e2ee-glm-5-2-p`. This model supports end-to-end encryption (E2EE) and runs in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). Your prompt is encrypted on your client and decrypted on the GPU within the TEE. The response is then encrypted and sent back to your client for decryption. Venice's system prompt and web search are disabled to preserve end-to-end encryption. Attestation evidence is available for independent verification. It is also available without end-to-end encryption, as [GLM 5.2](/models/glm-5-2).

GLM 5.2 running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). A Z.AI model for long-horizon tasks with enhanced reasoning and project-level engineering context, with hardware attestation evidence available for independent verification.

### How to use the GLM 5.2 E2EE API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "e2ee-glm-5-2-p"` and your API key.

This sample sends the prompt as plaintext, so the request runs TEE-only. For end-to-end encryption, send encrypted messages with the E2EE headers, as the [TEE and E2EE guide](/guides/features/tee-e2ee-models#e2ee-models) shows.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "e2ee-glm-5-2-p",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "low"
  }'
```
